hook.name: DarwinHook
hook.description: Collects a variable ETH tax (in basis points, sourced from the DARWIN token contract's currentTaxBps()) on DARWIN/ETH swaps: buy taxes are deducted from the ETH input via BeforeSwapDelta, sell taxes from the ETH output via AfterSwapDelta. Accumulated taxes are withdrawable by the owner. Only exact-input swaps in the DARWIN/ETH pool are supported.
